from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separators = set(sep_rows)
    separators_cols = set(sep_cols)
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in separators and c not in separators_cols]
    background = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    def segments(length, cuts):
        edges = [-1] + cuts + [length]
        return [list(range(edges[i] + 1, edges[i + 1])) for i in range(len(edges) - 1) if edges[i] + 1 < edges[i + 1]]
    rows, cols = segments(h, sep_rows), segments(w, sep_cols)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in rs for c in cs) == 2 else background for cs in cols] for rs in rows]
